intent.statement: Implement a new multilingual Speech Blocks pipeline based on deterministic atomic speech units, multilingual attribution detection, AI speaker assignment, validation, character hint improvements, tests, and documentation; do not preserve the old source-span-selection contract.

examples: A single span containing dialogue, attribution, dialogue, attribution, dialogue becomes five ordered atomic units before speaker assignment.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks shall derive final audiobook blocks from deterministic atomic speech units, allowing one source span to produce multiple ordered units while preserving exact source text coverage.

examples: Patterns such as quoted dialogue plus 'said/asked/spuse/intreba/dit/sagte/dijo' attribution plus more dialogue are separated into dialogue, narration, dialogue units.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks shall classify multilingual quoted, dash-led, attribution, and narration fragments structurally before the AI call so attribution narration is never merged into dialogue.

examples: Model output references unit IDs such as u001 and u002 rather than source text or source_span-only blocks.
spec_items.statement: The narrator-and-character AI contract shall assign speakers to existing atomic units only, using allowed speaker IDs, confidence, and warnings, and shall not split, merge, rewrite, translate, or return final text.

examples: A role speaker such as 'his agent' or Romanian source-language alias remains available as a prompt speaker hint.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks speaker detection shall use source-language character aliases, role labels, nearby attribution hints, and deterministic validation before falling back to narrator or ambiguous warning metadata.

examples: A separator atomic unit containing only newline characters is not sent as a selectable model unit and cannot produce an empty narrator Speech Block.
spec_items.statement: Speech Blocks shall treat separator-only or whitespace-only atomic units as non-speakable provenance, never as standalone persisted narrator or dialogue blocks, while requiring coverage of all selectable speakable atomic units.

examples: A quoted passage with two sentences must not split between the first sentence and the second sentence while the quote is still open.
spec_items.statement: Same-narrator Speech Blocks shall not expose or accept narrator-only split boundaries that divide a quoted passage so persisted blocks appear to lose opening or closing quotation marks, unless an unavoidable TTS-budget emergency split is explicitly warning-marked.

examples: A generated English narrator preview with 25 words remains accepted when it is one sentence, within the configured character cap, and long enough for the minimum Qwen TTS reference duration.
spec_items.statement: AI narrator profile generation shall accept valid single-sentence preview text across books and languages when it satisfies configured duration and character budgets, has no embedded line breaks, and only exceeds the prompt's target word range by a bounded tolerance.
spec_items.threshold: Validation must not depend on a specific book title, source-language vocabulary, or English-only sentence tokens; any upper tolerance must remain bounded and documented.
